skill.summary: Analyze and score any Amazon listing, find keyword opportunities, and spy on competitors for free with no API keys or subscriptions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Amazon Listing Optimizer 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Analyze and score any Amazon product listing for Title, Bullets, Images, and Reviews.
- Discover keyword opportunities using Amazon autocomplete with advanced crawling.
- Identify and analyze top competitors for any search term.
- 100% free: no API keys, subscriptions, or third-party dependencies required.
- Pure Python (standard library only); runs on any system with Python 3.6+.
